rework_notes: Spec-level acceptance rejected the landing (contract, definition-of-done) and rerouted to PBI_PLANNING. In src/quadra/canvas.py, _fold removes deleted cards from _cards without retaining their timestamp, while _is_stale only compares against a card still in _cards. A delayed insert, edit or relocation response arriving after another participant's confirmed deletion can therefore restore the older active card to the canvas, violating the Contract's authoritative persisted-state and reconciliation requirements. The soft-delete requirement is not reliably true across connected canvases: after a deletion notification removes a card, _submit, _save_edit or _show_confirmed can fold an older successful response back into the view. With no retained deletion version, the card can remain visible despite its persisted deleted_at being non-null. The Contract already correctly requires soft-deleted cards to disappear from connected canvases and Supabase to remain authoritative. This is a code-level reconciliation gap requiring an integration fix, such as retaining deletion versions and rejecting older operation responses, rather than a spec amendment.
